name: unslop
description: Plain-language editing for prose a person will read. Removes eleven recurring tics of machine-sounding writing — "it's not X, it's Y", borrowed-jargon modifiers ("load-bearing", "byte-identical", "surface area"), stacked nouns, SAT words, throat-clearing, empty amplifiers, inflated significance, manufactured profundity, rule-of-three lists, hedge stacks, and question mirroring — and rewrites each the way a person would say it. Includes a substitution phrasebook and a grep detector.
